name: Add Ticket Comment
plugin_description: Integrates with Zendesk to manage support tickets from Kizen agentic workflows.
action_description: Posts a public reply or an internal note on an existing ticket, optionally changing its status at the same time.

inputs.name: is_public
inputs.label: Is Public Comment
inputs.hint: True posts a public reply, visible to the requester; false posts an internal note, visible only to agents.

inputs.name: ticket_status
inputs.label: Status
inputs.hint: One of: new, open, pending, hold, solved, closed. Leave blank to leave status unchanged.

outputs.name: created_at
outputs.label: Created At
outputs.hint: ISO 8601 timestamp as returned by Zendesk.
